data.title: Calculating MyGame's levels
data.statement:
You will be given the [[xp]] of [[N]] MyGame's accounts.
For every account, you should output the [[level]] of the account. 
An account starts at Level {{0}}. It gains one level for every {{500}} XP it accumulates.
For example, with an [[xp]] of 1000, the [[level]] would be 2, and with an [[xp]] of 504, the [[level]] would be 1.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You will be given the xp of N MyGame's accounts.
For every account, you should output the level of the account.
An account starts at Level 0. It gains one level for every 500 XP it accumulates.
For example, with an xp of 1000, the level would be 2, and with an xp of 504, the level would be 1.
Input
Line 1 : An integer N, the number of MyGame's accounts
Next N lines : An integer xp, the xp of the account
Output
N lines : level, the level of the account based on its xp
Constraints
1 <= N <= 10
0 <= xp <= 10⁶
Example
Input
4
100
600
1700
1200
Output
Level 0
Level 1
Level 3
Level 2
